method: Split production core excludes the office-crypto feature and ships a separate decrypt-only module. All-in-one uses the combined core with office-crypto and omits the addon. Analysis variants remove icon dispatch/manifest entries, then stub the Office handler. Identical release settings and Binaryen -Oz --converge; probe uses a temporary source tree, so small path-related codegen differences are possible.

rows.name: without application icons or Office decryption
